inputs.original_text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. Organised by hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, the Together Alliance event was billed as the biggest [...] The post Protesters rally in London against UK far-right rise appeared first on Digital Journal .
inputs.modified_text:
Folks, we are seeing the true power of collective solidarity in real time. Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday to stand up against the dangerous rise of the far-right. This is what happens when working people, trade unions, anti-racism campaigners, and Muslim representative bodies organize together to protect vulnerable communities from systemic bigotry and fascist hate. 

Let's be clear about the stakes here: this massive mobilization by the Together Alliance comes just weeks ahead of key local elections, and it follows six months after Britain witnessed one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations. The establishment wants us to ignore the deep, structural roots of this hatred, but the hundreds of groups behind this march are demanding institutional reform and a firm stand against the forces of discrimination. We cannot afford to stay silent while marginalized groups are targeted. Solidarity is our only defense.
